39:32: Anwa i idensen sennig win iskaddben af Ṛebbi, iskaddben tideţ ma tusa t id? Day mačči di Loahennama, i illa uxxam ijehliyen?
39:33: Wid id iusan s tideţ, u ţţutebbten yis, wigi d wid iţḥezziben.
39:34: Ad sɛun ayen bɣan, ar Mass nnsen. D wagi ay d arraz iɛaṛḍiyen.
39:35: Iwakken ad asen Ikkes Ṛebbi, ayen xedmen adiran maḍi; a ten Iɣit s wayen xeddmen d amxallef.
39:36: Day ur Iţqam ara Ṛebbi amdan iS? La k ssagwaden s wid, war Neţţa. Win Itlef Ṛebbi, ur illi w ara t inhun.
39:37: Win Inha Ṛebbi, ur illi w ara t itelfen. Niɣ Ṛebbi d Uzmir, Bab n ţţaṛ.
39:38: Ma testeqsaḍ ten: "anwa i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan? Ad inin, war ccekk: d Ṛebbi". Ini: "ma twalam wigi tnaɛṛem, war Ṛebbi, day zemren, ma Ibɣa yi Ṛebbi ccqa, ad kksen ccqa S? Neɣ, ma Ibɣa yi aḥunu, ad ssbeṭlen aḥunu S"? Ini: "Iqennaɛ iyi Ṛebbi; fellaS ay ţţeklen wid iţkalen".
39:39: Ini: "a yagdud iw! Xedmet akken tennumen, nek la xeddmeɣ". Deqqal a ţţeẓṛem
39:40: anwa uɣuṛ ara d ias uɛaqeb ara t isdullen, uɣuṛ ara d irs uɛaqeb imezgi.
39:41: Ih, Nessader ed ɣuṛek, Tazmamt i medden, s tidets. Win iţwanhan, i iman is, win innetlafen, innetlaf kan, mgal is. Ur telliḍ, kečč, d awkil nnsen.
39:42: Ṛebbi Iţţaddam leṛwaḥ mara mmten, akked wid ur nemmut, deg iḍes nnsen. Iɛatteq wid iɣef Iseyya tameţţant, Iţţara d wiyaḍ, ar lajel iţwassnen. Ih, deg wayagi, ard issekniyen i ugdud iţmeyyizen.
39:43: Neɣ ad ddmen, war Ṛebbi, imcafɛan? Ini: "i ma ur sɛin acemma, ur fhimen"?
39:44: Ini: "akw ccafuɛa n Ṛebbi. IneS tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Sinna, ɣuṛeS ara tuɣalem".
39:45: Mara d Iţwadder Ṛebbi Yiwen, ad zemḍen wulawen n wid ur numin ara s laxeṛt. Ma ţwadren d wid, war Neţţa, imiren nitni ad ceṛḥen.
39:46: Ini: "a Ṛebbi! Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan, Amusnaw n wayen iffren d wayen iḍehṛen, d Kečč ara Iḥudden ger imdanen iK, ɣef wayen llan mgarraden".
39:47: Wid idensen, lemmer nnsen ayen akw i illan di tmurt, rnu yas am neţţa, ur ten id ifeddu, seg uɛaqeb ucmit, ass n tnekra. Ad asen d iban, sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, ayen iɣef ur bnin.
39:48: Ad asen d banent tucmitin kesben, ad asen inneḍ wayen iɣef ttahan.
39:49: Ma iḥuza umdan ccqa, ad aɣ d inɛaṛ. Sinna, ma Nezger tacḍaṭ nneɣ fellas, ad yini: "tusa yi d kan si tmusni". Xaṭi! D ajeṛṛeb, maca aṭas degsen ur ssinen.
39:50: Niɣ nnan t id imezwura nnsen. Acu i sen d ibbwi wayen keţţben?
39:51: Iwwet iten wayen kesben n tucmitin. Wid idensen, seg wigi, a ten iwwet wayen kesben n tucmitin. Ur zmiren ad sfunngen.
39:52: Day ur ẓṛin ara ar Ṛebbi Iţɣiti win i S ihwan, u Iwezzen? Ih, deg waya, ard issekniyen i ugdud iumnen.
39:53: Ini: "a yimdanen iw i iţḥawalen mgal iman nnsen! Ur ţţayset aḥunu n Ṛebbi. Ih, Ṛebbi Iţsemmiḥ akw ibekkaḍen. Ih, Neţţa Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
39:54: Steṛoɛet i Mass nnwen, anzet aS, uqbel a kwen id ias uɛaqeb, dɣa ula ikwen isellken.
39:55: Ddut d ṣṣam n wayen i wen d irsen, sɣuṛ Mass nnwen, uqbel a kwen id ias uɛaqeb, deqzalla, kunwi ur tebnim";
39:56: u a d yini ṛṛuḥ: "a ssexḍ iw, ɣef wayen stehzaɣ ar loiha n Ṛebbi! Lliɣ, s tideţ, seg wid ittihin".
39:57: Neɣ a d yini: "lemmer iyi Inha Ṛebbi, yili lliɣ seg wid iţḥezziben".
39:58: Neɣ a d yini mara iwali aɛaqeb: "lemmer iyi illi wallus, ad iliɣ si lɛuṣam".
39:59: Xaṭi! Usan k id issekniyen iW, teskaddbeḍ ten, tzuxxeḍ, telliḍ seg ijehliyen.
39:60: Ass n tnekra, a ţwaliḍ berrikit wudmawen n wid id igren tikerkas af Ṛebbi. Day mačči di Loahennama, i illa uxxam imzuxiyen?
39:61: Ad Isellek Ṛebbi wid iḥezzben; ar rebḥen. Ur ten ikkat wugur, ur ɣwebbnen.
39:62: Ṛebbi Ixleq yal cci. Neţţa d Awkil n yal cci.
39:63: IneS tsura n tmurt akked igenwan. Wid inekṛen issekniyen n Ṛebbi, widak d imexsuṛen.
39:64: Ini: "day ad yi tamṛem ad ɛabdeɣ, war Ṛebbi, a wid ur nessin"?
39:65: Niɣ iusa k id uweḥḥi, u ɣeṛ wid i k izwaren. Ma tcurkeḍ, ad mḥun igiten ik, a ţţiliḍ seg imexsuṛen.
39:66: Xaṭi! Aɛbed Ṛebbi. Ili seg wid isnemmiren.
39:67: Ur qudṛen ara Ṛebbi, azal n lqedṛ iS. Akw tamurt, ass n tnekra, di tumeẓt iS. Igenwan ad nnefḍasen deg ufus iS ayeffus. Gedha s yiS! I Aɛlay sennig wayen ţcaraken!
39:68: Aṣuḍu di lbuq: ad ixsef i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt, kkes ed i S ihwan i Ṛebbi. Aṣuḍu nniḍen: nitni a d kkren ţmuqulen.
39:69: A ţfeooeo tmurt, si tafat n Mass is. A d ters Tezmamt, a d awin lambiyya akked inagan. Ad ɛaddin di ccṛaɛ, s tideţ, ur ţwadensen.
39:70: Yal yiwen ad iɣellet ayen ixdem. Neţţa, Yif akw akken Issen, d acu xeddmen.
39:71: Ad ţwanehṛen wid ijehlen, d igrawen, ar Loahennama. Mi bbwḍen ɣuṛes, u llint tebbura s, ad asen inin iɛssasen is: "day ur kwen in usan ara imazanen, segwen, mmalen awen issekniyen n Mass nnwen, nedṛen kwen af temlilit n wass nnwen agi"? A d inin: "Ih. Maca, ad iṣaṛ wawal uɛaqeb, af ijehliyen".
39:72: A d inin: "kecmet si tebbura, ar Loahennama! Degs, wekkṛet". Ay d ucmit uxxam n imzuxiyen!
39:73: Wid iḥezzben i Mass nnsen, ad ţwanehṛen ar Loennet, d igrawen. Mi bbwḍen ɣuṛes, u llint tebbura s, ad asen inin iɛssasen is: "tifrat fellawen, tgerzem; kecmet eţ, twekkṛem"!
39:74: Ad inin: "ccekṛan i Ṛebbi i ɣ Issawḍen lemɛahda S. Ifka yaɣ tamurt d lweṛt; a nili, di Loennet, anda i ɣ ihwa. A yarraz asaɛdi n wid ixeddmen lxiṛ!
39:75: A ţwaliḍ lmalayek zzint ed i usgeld, sbuccuɛent s ccekṛan Mass nnsent. Iɛadda ccṛaɛ garasen, s tideţ. Ad inin: "a neckeṛ Ṛebbi, Mass imaḍalen".
40:2: Tarusi n Tezmamt, sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, Uzmir, Amusnaw;
40:3: Iţsemmiḥen tuccḍa, Iqeblen nndama, Iţɛaqaben s teqseḥ, Bab n terkunt. Ur illi ṛebbi siwa Neţţa. ɣuṛeS taggara.
40:4: Siwa wid ijehlen i iţnamaren ɣef issekniyen n Ṛebbi. Ur k iţɣuṛṛu ucali nnsen, di tmurt.
40:5: Uqbel nitni, agdud n Nuḥ, akked ikabaren deffir sen, skaddben. Yal lois iclaɛ ad ixḍef amazan is. Iţnamar s tkerkas, iwakken, s yissent, ad iḍeggeṛ tideţ. Ḥekmeɣ ten. A tiyta W imiren!
40:6: Akka iṣaṛ wawal n Mass ik, af wid ijehlen. Nitni, war ccekk, d at tmes.
40:7: Tid irefden asgeld, akked tid i s izzin, sbuccuɛen s ccekṛan Mass nnsent, umnent yiS. Ssuturent ad ţwasemmḥen wid iumnen: "a Mass nneɣ! Terriḍ yal cci d aḥunu, u d tamusni. Semmeḥ i wid isteṛoɛen u ddan d ubrid iK; Sellek iten seg uɛaqeb n wuɣud.
40:8: A Mass nneɣ! Ssekcem iten ar leonanat n Ɛaden, i Tɛahdeḍ, i nitni, u i iɛaṛḍiyen seg ibabaten nnsen, tilawin nnsen, tarwa nnsen. Kečč, ih, d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
40:9: Aɛteq iten si tucmitin. Win Tɛatqeḍ, assen, si tucmitin, niɣ Tḥuneḍ fellas. D wagi ay d rrbeḥ ameqwṛaḥan".
40:10: Ad ţwanecden wid ijehlen: "taɛdawt n Ṛebbi teɣleb taɛdawt bbwaygarawen. Mi teţwanecdem ar liman, tugim".
40:11: A d inin: "a Mass nneɣ! Tenɣiḍ aɣ berdayen, Tessidreḍ aɣ berdayen. Nqaṛṛ s ibekkaḍen nneɣ. Day illa ubrid n tuffɣa"?
40:12: Akka, imi mara iţwanɛaṛ Ṛebbi Yiwen, kunwi tjehlem. Mara S ţcaraken, kunwi tumnem. Aḥuddu ar Ṛebbi Aɛlayen, Ameqwṛan.
40:13: D Neţţa i wen Issnaɛtan issekniyen iS. Issadar awen d lɣit, seg igenni. Siwa win isteṛoiɛen, id ismektayen.
40:14: Nujet ɣuṛ Ṛebbi, s laɛqida i Neţţa, xas ugin ijehliyen.
40:15: Aɛlayen nnig idurra, Bab n usgeld, Iţţak ṛṛuḥ s lameṛ iS, i win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS, iwakken ad indeṛ af wass umlili,
40:16: ass ideg ara d awḍen, ur illi wayen iffren, degsen, i Ṛebbi. W iţ ilan tgelda, assen? D Ṛebbi, Yiwen, Aqehhaṛ.
40:17: Ass ideg ara iţţuqeṭṭi yal iman ɣef wayen ikseb; ur iţţili ddens assen. Ih, Ṛebbi Iţɣawal deg uqeṭṭi.
40:18: Nabi ten af ass aqṛib, ideg ulawen ad rewlen s igerjumen, ad qebṛen. Ur iţţilli i imednas, uḥbib neɣ amcafaɛ, iwumi ara ssemḥessen.
40:19: Issen nncub n yiẓṛi, akked wayen teffren idmaren.
40:20: Ṛebbi Iferru s tideţ. Wid iţnujun ar war Neţţa, ur qeṭṭun acemma. Ih, Ṛebbi d Win Isellen, Iţwalin.
40:21: Day ur nudan ara tamurt, ad walin amek teḍṛa d wid i ten id izwaren. Llan ifen ten tazmert, akked lateṛ, di tmurt. Issemḥelleq asen Ṛebbi, ilmend ibekkaḍen nnsen. Ur asen illi umḥareb, mgal Ṛebbi.
40:22: Akka, acku ţţasen ɣuṛsen, imazanen nnsen, s ubeggen, u nitni jehlen. Issemḥelleq asen Ṛebbi. Ih, Neţţa, d Uzmir, d Bab uɛaqeb uqsiḥ.
40:23: Niɣ Nuzen ed Musa s issekniyen nneɣ, s udabu iberrzen,
40:24: ar Ferɛun, Haman, akked Qaṛun. Nnan: "d aseḥḥar, d akeddab".
40:25: Mi sen d iusa, s tideţ s ɣuṛneɣ, nnan: "enɣet arrac n wid iumnen yides, ssidret tilawin nnsen". Tandit ijehliyen siwa di ttelfan.
40:26: Inna Ferɛun: "anfet iyi ad nɣeɣ Musa, xas ad inuj ar Mass is. Ugadeɣ, nek, ad ibeddel ddin nnwen, neɣ a d issekcem lefsad di tmurt".
40:27: Inna Musa: "nek, ad iyi Iṣṣeṛ Mass iw u Mass nnwen, si yal amzuxi, ur numin s wass uqeṭṭi".
40:28: Inna urgaz lmumen, i iffren liman is, si twacult n Ferɛun: "day a ţţenɣem argaz, imi d iqqaṛ: Mass iw d Ṛebbi, u irna ibbwi yawen d abeggen, sɣuṛ Mass nnwen? Ma iskaddeb, lkedb is fellas. Ma issawel tideţ, a kwen iḥaz kra seg wayen ikwen issagwad. Ṛebbi ur Inehhu amaɛfun iskiddiben.
40:29: A yagdud iw! Assa, nnwen tagelda, tufrarem di tmurt. W ad aɣ isellken si tiyta n Ṛebbi, ma tusa yaɣ d"? Inna d Ferɛun: "i wen ssekneɣ ayen kan walaɣ; s anda i kwen nehhuɣ, siwa ar ubrid imaɛnen".
40:30: Inna d win iumnen: "a yagdud iw! Nek, ugadeɣ fellak tin n wass ikabaren,
40:31: akken teḍṛa d ugdud n Nuḥ, Ɛad, Tamud, akked wid i ten id iḍefṛen. Ṛebbi ur Ibɣa ara ddens i imdanen.
40:32: A yagdud iw! Nek ugadeɣ, ay kwen iţţaɣen, ass umnamar,
40:33: ass ideg ara trewlem ar deffir. Ur awen illi umḥareb mgal Ṛebbi. Ur illi nnahi i win Itlef Ṛebbi".
40:34: Niɣ iusa kwen id Yusef, zik, s ubeggen. Tezgam di ccekk, ɣef wayen i wen d ibbwi. Armi immut, tennam: "ur d Iţţazen ara Ṛebbi amazan, deffir es, d awezɣi". Akka i Itellif Ṛebbi amaɛfun amcekki.
40:35: Wid iţnamaren issekniyen n Ṛebbi, ur ten id iusi udabu, nezzeh ara ten iɣunfu Ṛebbi, akked wid iumnen. Akka ara Icemmaɛ Ṛebbi, yal ul amzuxi, aɛfrit.
40:36: Inna Ferɛun: "a Haman, bnu yi lbeṛo, amar ad awḍeɣ ar iberdan,
40:37: iberdan igenwan. Ad aliɣ ar Ṛebbi n Musa. Nek ḥesbeɣ t d akeddab". Akka i s iţţucebbeḥ i Ferɛun, igi s ucmit. Iţţuḍeṛṛef seg ubrid. Tandit n Ferɛun, siwa taxeṣṣart.
40:38: Inna d win iumnen: "a yagdud iw! Ddu yidi, a k nhuɣ s abrid umɛin.
40:39: A yagdud iw! Tameddurt agi, di ddunit, d zzhu kan; wanag laxeṛt d axxam n leqṛaṛ.
40:40: Win ixedmen tucmiţ, ad iţţuqeṭṭi, kan, s tin i ţ icban. Wid ixedmen ayen ilhan, d ddkeṛ neɣ d nnta, u nitni umnen, widak ad kecmen Loennet; din, ad aten ɣiten, war aktili.
40:41: A yagdud iw! Acu iyi bbwin, a kwen neccdeɣ ar leslak; kunwi, a yi tneccdem ar tmessi?
40:42: A yi tneccdem ad aɛṣuɣ Ṛebbi, ad aS carkeɣ ayen ur ssineɣ. Nek, neccdeɣ kwen ar Uzmir Iţsemmiḥen
40:43: War ccekk, ayen uɣuṛ a yi tneccdem, ur as iwata unuju di ddunit, u di laxeṛt. Ih, tuɣalin nneɣ ar Ṛebbi. Imaɛfan ard at tmes.
40:44: A d tesmektim ayen i wen qqaṛeɣ. Ṛṛay iw fkiɣ t i Ṛebbi. Niɣ Ṛebbi Iţwali imdanen".
40:45: Isellek it Ṛebbi si tucmitin i undin. Iɣwellef lois n Ferɛun, s uɛaqeb iugaren wiyaḍ:
40:46: times. Ad ţwafessren degs, ṣṣbeḥ, tameddit. Ass ideg ara d ias yimir: "ekcem, a lois n Ferɛun, aɛaqeb uwɛiṛ maḍi"!
40:47: Mara ţţemqellaɛen di tmes, ad inin uṛhifen i imzuxiyen: "niɣ nella nedda yidwen. Ma tzemrem, kunwi, ad aɣ tesneqsem cwiṭ, si tmes"?
40:48: A d inin imzuxiyen: "aql aɣ, akw, degs. S tideţ, Ṛebbi Iḥudd ger imdanen".
40:49: Ad inin wid illan di tmes, i iɛessasen n Loahennama: "naɛṛet Mass nnwen, ad aɣ Issifes ibwass uɛaqeb".
40:50: Ad inin: "day ur kwen id usan ara imazanen nnwen, s ubeggen"? Ad inin: "ih". Ad inin: "naɛret"! Ar ttelfan, kan, tanaɛrit ijehliyen.
40:51: War ccekk, a Nsellek imazanen nneɣ, akked wid iumnen, di tmeddurt n ddunit, u deg wass ideg ara d bedden inagan,
40:52: ass ideg ur infaɛ usteɣfeṛ imednas. Ad ţwaxzun, ad zedɣen deg uxxam ucmit maḍi.
40:53: Niɣ Nefka, i Musa, nnhaya. Nefka, i At Isṛail, Tazmamt d lweṛt.
40:54: D nnhaya, u d asmekti i uɛqilen.
40:55: Eṣbeṛ. Ih, lemɛahda n Ṛebbi, d tideţ. Ssuter ssmaḥ ubekkaḍ ik. Sbuccaɛ s ccekṛan Mass ik, tameddit, taṣebḥit.
40:56: Ih, wid iţnamaren issekniyen n Ṛebbi, ur ten id iusi udabu, d temɣweṛ kan i illan deg idmaren nnsen; ur as ssawḍen. Ggani Ṛebbi, Neţţa, s tideţ, Isell, Iţwali.
40:57: Ih, lxelq n tmurt akked igenwan iugar lxelq n imdanen, maca aṭas n imdanen ur ẓṛin.
40:58: Ur iaɛdil ara uderɣal akked win iţwalin, wid iumnen u xeddmen ayen ilhan, akked bu tucmitin. Cwiṭ id tesmektayem.
40:59: Ihi, imir a d ias, ur illi ccekk fellas, maca tegwti n imdanen ur uminen.
40:60: Inna Mass nnwen: "naɛret iyI, ad awen d Jawbeɣ. Wanag wid igelzen aɛbed iW, ad kecmen Loahennama, d imedlulen".
40:61: Ṛebbi i wen Irran iḍ, i ureyyeḥ degs, ass i tmuɣli. Ṛebbi, ih, d Bab n lfeḍl i imdanen, maca tegwti n imdanen, ur snemmiren.
40:62: D wagi ay d Ṛebbi, Mass nnwen. Ixleq yal cci, ur illi ṛebbi, siwa Neţţa. Ihi, acimi tezzim akin?
40:63: Akka ay wexxṛen wid iugin issekniyen n Ṛebbi.
40:64: Ṛebbi i wen Irran tamurt d leqṛaṛ, igenni d ssqef; ikwen Imeslen. Iṣeggem udem nnwen. Iɣat ikwen s wayen ilhan. D wagi ay d Ṛebbi, Mass nnwen. D Asaɛdi Ṛebbi, Mass imaḍalen.
40:65: Neţţa d Amuddir, ur illi ṛebbi siwa Neţţa. Ihi, naɛṛet eP, s lɛaqida i Neţţa. Ccekṛan i Ṛebbi, Mass imaḍalen.
40:66: Ini: "nek, iţwakkes iyi uɛbad n wid tnaɛrem war Ṛebbi, mi yi d iusa ubeggen, sɣuṛ Mass iw. Pwamṛeɣ d, ad anzeɣ i Mass imaḍalen.
40:67: Neţţa, ikwen Ixelqen seg wakal; sinna, si tiqqit; sinna, seg urgen; sinna, Issuffeɣ ikwen id d igwerdan; sinna, a ţţimɣuṛem; sinna, a ţţuɣalem d imɣaṛen. Kra segwen, ţmeţţaten uqbel. Iwakken a ţţawḍem ar lajel iţwassnen. Amendeṛ ma a ţfehmem.
40:68: D Neţţa i Issidiren, i Ineqqen. Ma Iseyya d lameṛ, ad as Yini kan: "ili"! Ad yili.
40:69: Day ur twalaḍ ara amek ssuffɣen i ubrid, wid iţnamaren issekniyen n Ṛebbi?
40:70: Wid iskaddben Tazmamt, akked wayen iɣef id Nuzen imazanen nneɣ, deqqal ad ẓṛen.
40:72: ar waman iţţayzagen; sinna, ar tmes, ad ţwaḍeggṛen;
40:73: sinna, ad asen inin: "anda t wayen teţcarakem
40:74: war Ṛebbi"? A d inin: "dergen fellaɣ. Xaṭi! Ur illi wayen uɣuṛ neţnuju, zik". Akka i Itellif Ṛebbi ijehliyen.
40:75: Akka, ɣef wayen tzehhum di tmurt, ur teklalem, akked wayen tqebḥem.
40:76: Kecmet Loahennama, si tebbura; degs twekkṛem. Ay dir tanezduɣt imzuxiyen!
40:77: Eṣbeṛ, war ccekk, lemɛahda n Ṛebbi d tideţ. Ad ak Nessken kra n wayen i sen Nɛahed, neɣ a Neddem ṛṛuḥ ik. ɣuṛneɣ ara d uɣalen.
40:78: Niɣ Nuzen ed imazanen uqbel ik. ɣef kra segsen, Neḥka yak d. ɣef kra nniḍen, ur ak d Neḥka ara. Ur iwata ara i umazan, a d iawi assekni, siwa ma s tsriḥ n Ṛebbi. Ma iusa d lameṛ n Ṛebbi, aseyyi s tideţ. Ad xesṛen, imiren, laɛṛuṛ.
40:79: Ṛebbi i wen Ifkan lmal i rekba nnwen. Segsen teţţeţţem.
40:80: Degsen, i kunwi, abaɣuṛ akked agwaḍ ar wayen id ssuturen idmaren nnwen. Fellasen, akw f ssfinat, teţţɛabbim.
40:81: Issenɛat awen d issekniyen iS. Anwi issekniyen n Ṛebbi ara tnekṛem?
40:82: Day ur nudan ara tamurt ad walin amek teḍṛa d wid i ten id izwaren. Llan ifen ten akken ṭṭuqten, ifen ten tazmert akked lateṛ di tmurt. Ulay sen d ibbwi wayen la keţţben.
40:83: Mi ten id usan imazanen nnsen s ubeggen, feṛḥen s tmusni i illan ɣuṛsen. Izzi fellasen wayen iɣef ţţemsexxiṛen.
40:84: Mi walan tamnirt nneɣ, nnan: "numen s Ṛebbi Yiwen, nḍeggeṛ ayen i nella ncurek aS".
40:85: Ur izmir ara a ten infaɛ liman nnsen, mi walan tamnirt nneɣ. D tannumi n Ṛebbi, si zik, i imdanen iS. Akka ay xesṛen ijehliyen.
41:3: Tazmamt, feṣṣlen issekniyen is; Leqwṛan s taɛṛabt, i ugdud issnen,
41:4: iţbecciṛen, ineddṛen. Tegwti degsen numren, dɣa ur sellen.
41:5: Nnan: "ulawen nneɣ ddurin i wayen iɣeṛ la ɣ tneccdeḍ; di tmejjin nneɣ: tiɛẓegt; garaneɣ yidek: sṭeṛ. Ihi, exdem, nekwni la nxeddem".
41:6: Ini: "nek d amdan kan, am kunwi. Weḥḥan iyi d kan ar Ṛebbi nnwen, d Ṛebbi Yiwen. Sweqmet ɣuṛeS, ssutret aS ssmaḥ". A tawaɣit n imcurak,
41:7: wid ur neţzekki, u nitni nekṛen laxeṛt!
41:8: Ih, i wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan: arraz ur neţnegzay.
41:9: Ini: "kunwi aql akwen la tnekṛem Win Ixelqen tamurt, di sin wussan. La S teţţaram nned. Wagi d Mass imaḍalen.
41:10: Irra degs idurar sufella. Iṛqa ţ, Iwzen degs tagwella s, di kuẓ wussan. Akka i wid isteqsayen.
41:11: Sinna, Izzi ar igenni i illan d abbu. Inna yas, u i tmurt: "aset ed, tebɣam neɣ tugim"! Nnan: "a n nas, d imḍuɛen".
41:12: Iseyya ten d ṣa igenwan, di sin wussan. Iweḥḥa lameṛ is, i yal igenni. Ncebbeḥ igenni aqṛib maḍi, s teftilin, u d laɛnaya. D aya ay d Iqeddeṛ n Uzmir, Amusnaw.
41:13: Ma numren, ini: "ssagwdeɣ kwen s ssiɛqa, am ssiɛqa n Ɛad u Tamud".
41:14: Mi ten id usan imazanen, zdat sen, u deffir sen: "ur ɛabdet, siwa Ṛebbi"! Nnan: "lemmer i S ihwi i Mass nneɣ, a d Issers lmalayek. Nekwni, ihi, nenkeṛ ayen i s id teţţuceggɛam".
41:15: Wanag Ɛad, smeɣwṛen iman nnsen di tmurt, ur klalen. Nnan: "anwa i ɣ iɣelben di tezmert"? Day ur walan ara, Ṛebbi, iten id Ixelqen, Iɣelb iten di tezmert? Llan la nekṛen issekniyen nneɣ.
41:16: Nuzen asen aṣeṛṣaṛ, deg ussan imeḍyaṛen, iwakken a Nessukk fellasen, aɛaqeb imdelli di tmeddurt n ddunit. Aɛaqeb n laxeṛt, war ccekk, isdullu kteṛ. Ur asen iţţili umɛiwen.
41:17: Wanag Tamud, Nebbwi ten d ubrid. Smenyafen tiderɣelt i nnhaya. Tewwet iten ssiɛqa n uɛaqeb issrusun, ilmend n wayen keţţben.
41:19: Ass ideg ara ssemlilen ar tmessi, icenga n Ṛebbi, nitni ad ţwajemmlen.
41:20: Alamma, mara awḍen ɣuṛes, ad cehhden fellasen, ɣef wayen xeddmen, imeẓẓuɣen nnsen, allen nnsen, d igwelman nnsen.
41:21: Ad inin i igwelman nnsen: "acimi id tcuhhdem fellaɣ"? A d inin: "Issenṭeq aɣ d Ṛebbi, id Issentaqen yal cci. Neţţa, Ixelq ikwen tikelt tamezwarut, u ɣuṛeS ara tuɣalem".
41:22: Ur tezmirem ara a ţţeffrem, ur cehhden fellawen imeẓẓuɣen nnwen, allen nnwen, akked igwelman nnwen. Maca, tɣilem ur Iẓeṛ ara Ṛebbi, aṭas n wayen txeddmem.
41:23: Akka ameyyez nnwen ɣef Mass nnwen. Isqucc ikwen, tegwram d d imexsuṛen.
41:24: Xas ṣebṛen, di tmes ara zedɣen. Ma ssutren ssmaḥ, ur llin d wid ara iţwaqeblen.
41:25: Nefka yasen imeddukwal i sen icebbḥen ayen illan zdat sen, akked wayen illan deffir sen. Iṣaṛ fellasen wawal ger leoyus n yimdanen akw n leonun, i iɣaben, uqbel nnsen. Ih, nitni d imexsuṛen.
41:26: Nnan wid ijehlen: "ur ssemḥaset i Leqwṛan agi. Ssekret fellas, taɣwegwa, ahat a ţrebḥem".
41:27: A Nessukk ɣef wid ijehlen, aɛaqeb uqsiḥ. A ten Nqeṭṭi sennig wayen xeddmen.
41:28: D wagi ay d aqeṭṭi icenga n Ṛebbi: times; i nitni degs axxam n lebda; d aqeṭṭi, imi la nekṛen issekniyen nneɣ.
41:29: Ad inin, wid ijehlen: "a Mass nneɣ! Essken aɣ wid i ɣ iɣelṭen, d loenn neɣ d amdan; a ten neṛkeḍ, ad uɣalen seg wid indellen maḍi".
41:30: Ih, wid innan: "Mass nneɣ d Ṛebbi", sinna, nudan lewqama, a d rsent ɣuṛsen lmalayek: "ur ţţagwadet, ur ɣwebblet; ţţubeccṛet s Loennet i wen iţţuwaɛɛden".
41:31: Nekwni d imawlan nnwen di tmeddurt n ddunit u di laxeṛt. Dinna, i kunwi, ayen i cedhant teṛwiḥin nnwen. Dinna, i kunwi, ayen tessutrem.
41:33: Anwa yifen awal umɛin n win inaɛṛen Ṛebbi, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, id innan: "nek, ih, seg imḍuɛen".
41:34: Ur iaɛdil iseɣ akked tucmiţ. Err iţ akin, s wayen iţ yifen. Ma tella cceḥna, garak d yiwen, ad iuɣal d aḥbib i k iḥemmlen.
41:35: Ur teţţunefk siwa i wid iṣebbṛen. Ur teţţunefk, siwa i bu sser abarar.
41:36: Ma iccaceḍ ak Cciṭan tuccḍa, ssuter laɛnaya n Ṛebbi. Ih, Neţţa d win Isellen, d Amusnaw.
41:37: Seg issekniyen iS, ass akked yiḍ, iṭij akked waggur. Ur kennut ara i yiṭij, neɣ i waggur. Knut i Ṛebbi, iten id Ixelqen, ma d Neţţa ay tɛabbdem.
41:38: Ma zuxxen, ihi, wid illan ar Mass ik, sbuccuɛen T iḍ akked wass, ur ɛaggun.
41:39: Seg issekniyen iS: a ţwaliḍ, kečč, akal iqquṛ; lemmer ad as Nesseɣli aman, a d iakwi, ad icuff. Win it id Issadren, d Win ara d Issidren lmeggtin. Ih, Neţţa, Izmer i yal cci.
41:40: Ih, wid issexṣaṛen issekniyen nneɣ, ur drigen fellaneɣ. Menyif win ara iţwaḍeggṛen ar tmes, neɣ win ara iasen di laman, ass n tnekra? Xedmet ayen i wen ihwan. Neţţa, s tideţ, Iţwali ayen txeddmem.
41:41: Akka, wid inekṛen asmekti, mi ten id iusa, u neţţat ard Tazmamt tuzmirt.
41:42: Ur d iusi leɣwlaḍ zdat es, neɣ deffir es. D tarusi sɣuṛ Bab n ṣṣwab, Amaɛzuz.
41:43: Awal i k id iusan, d win kan id iusan imazanen, uqbel ik. Mass ik, ih, ard Bab n ssmaḥ, d Bab uɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
41:44: Lemmer Nerri Leqwṛan s tmeslayt tabeṛṛanit, a d inin: "lemmer feṣṣlen issekniyen iS s wawal abeṛṛani, u s taɛṛabt"? Ini: "neţţa, i wid iumnen, d nnhaya u d ccafuɛa. Wid ur numin ara, ɛaẓgent tmejjin nnsen. Neţţa, i nitni, d tiderɣelt. Widak ţwanecden seg umkan ibaɛden".
41:45: Niɣ Nefka yas Tazmamt i Musa. Mgarraden fellas. Lemmer ur d izwar ara wawal sɣuṛ Mass ik, yili tefra garasen. Nitni, fellas, di ccekk imcebbwel.
41:46: Win ixedmen ayen ilhan, i iman is; win iccḍen, mgal iman is. Mass ik ur Idennis ara imdanen.
